pages.name: Bahatko
pages.text: A fireball that guards the Heatland from outsiders.

pages.title: Behaviour
pages.text: Bahatkos float over the land and attack everything that does not live here; a wounded one calls its kin. They strike, set you alight, fly off and return.$(br2)Water quenches them: they leave an $(item)ember$(), a fuel that burns three times as long as coal.

pages.title: Fire draws attention
pages.text: When you take the result from a furnace, smoker, blast furnace or brewing stand in the Heatland, a Bahatko may be lured to the fire. It hangs in sparks for a few seconds, giving you time to prepare.$(br2)A Klunnyk protects you from their burning.
